$comment: Functional baseline of the protected xenios routes, captured against the LIVE
production origin with read-only GETs. Regenerate with:
Read 'interpretation' before treating title/meta/canonical as per-route evidence.
method: GET only, redirect: manual, no auth, no cookies, no forms

interpretation.renderingModel: client-rendered SPA (wouter); the server returns one index.html shell for every path
interpretation.note: title/metaDescription/canonical are identical on every route because SeoHead sets them in the browser after hydration. A change to any of them moves every route's bodySha256 at once, which is exactly the tripwire we want on client/index.html.

invariants.assertion: every protected route returns 200 and the SPA shell
no protected route carries an x-robots-tag response header

the /research and /care page gates keep sending x-robots-tag: noindex, nofollow. This is the only per-route server signal on this origin, so it is the sharpest cross-check that a Research or Care change did not leak its gate onto the main site, or drop it from its own.
every 200 protected route returns one identical index.html shell hash

observedDeploymentNotes.note: the deployed edge answers this path before the SPA router sees it; the repo route is recorded in the manifest, this is what production actually does today
